rebel against authority: Some teenagers rebel against authority by breaking school rules and ignoring what their teachers say.
有些青少年以違反校規、無視老師的話來反抗權威。
rebel against one's parents: When he was sixteen, Tom began to rebel against his parents and stayed out late every night.
湯姆十六歲時開始反抗父母，每晚都很晚才回家。
the stomach rebels: Whenever I eat too much fried chicken, the stomach rebels and I feel sick for hours.
每當我吃太多炸雞，胃就不舒服，我會難受好幾個小時。
teenage rebellion: Dyeing his hair green was just a small act of teenage rebellion, and his parents soon laughed about it.
把頭髮染成綠色只是青少年叛逆的小舉動，他爸媽很快就一笑置之。
recall a product: The car company decided to recall a product after many drivers reported problems with its brakes.
在許多駕駛回報煞車有問題後，這家汽車公司決定召回產品。
recall the past: Looking at old photos, my grandfather loves to recall the past and tell us stories about his childhood.
看著老照片，我爺爺喜歡回憶過去，跟我們說他童年的故事。
recall an ambassador: After the serious argument between the two countries, the government decided to recall an ambassador from abroad.
兩國發生嚴重爭執後，政府決定從國外召回大使。
I can't recall: I know I've met that man somewhere before, but I can't recall where or when it was.
我知道我以前在哪裡見過那個男人，但我想不起來是在哪裡或什麼時候。
recall a name: My teacher can recall a name after hearing it just once, even though she has over two hundred students.
我的老師只要聽過一次就能想起名字，即使她有兩百多個學生。
recognize a face: Even after twenty years, she could still recognize a face she had seen only once at the train station.
即使過了二十年，她仍能認出一張只在火車站見過一次的面孔。
recognize the problem: The first step to solving any difficulty is to recognize the problem and admit that it exists.
解決任何困難的第一步，是意識到問題並承認它存在。
recognize one's achievements: The school held a special ceremony to recognize her achievements in science and music.
學校舉辦了一場特別典禮來肯定她在科學和音樂上的成就。
recognize a government: Many countries refused to recognize a government that had taken power by force.
許多國家拒絕承認一個以武力奪權的政府。
be recognized as: Taipei 101 was once officially recognized as the tallest building in the world.
台北101曾經被正式公認為世界最高的建築。
recognize the signs: Parents should learn to recognize the signs of stress in their children, such as poor sleep and loss of appetite.
父母應該學會辨認孩子的壓力徵兆，例如睡不好和食慾不振。
recommend a book: When I asked for something fun to read, the librarian recommended a book about friendship.
當我想找有趣的讀物時，圖書館員推薦了一本關於友誼的書。
recommend caution: Because the roads are icy, the police recommend caution when driving in the mountains this week.
由於路面結冰，警方建議本週在山區開車時要謹慎。
have much to recommend it: The old apartment is small, but it has much to recommend it, including a quiet street and a lovely view.
這間舊公寓雖小，但很值得推薦，包括安靜的街道和美麗的景色。
highly recommended: This restaurant is highly recommended by food bloggers, so we booked a table a month ahead.
這家餐廳受到美食部落客強烈推薦，所以我們提前一個月訂位。
reconcile differences: The two friends met for coffee to reconcile differences after months of not speaking to each other.
這兩個朋友在幾個月互不說話後，約出來喝咖啡化解分歧。
be reconciled with: After years of silence, he was finally reconciled with his brother at their mother's birthday party.
沉默多年後，他終於在母親的生日派對上與哥哥和解。
reconcile work and family: Many working parents find it hard to reconcile work and family, especially when their kids are young.
許多上班族父母覺得很難兼顧工作與家庭，尤其是孩子還小的時候。
reconcile oneself to: After the injury, she had to reconcile herself to the fact that she could never dance again.
受傷之後，她必須接受現實：她再也不能跳舞了。
record a song: My sister used her phone to record a song she wrote, and then she shared it with her friends online.
我姊姊用手機錄下她寫的歌，然後在網路上分享給朋友。
record the temperature: Every morning, the students record the temperature outside and write it in their science notebooks.
每天早上，學生們記錄室外溫度，並寫在自然科筆記本上。
record a profit: Thanks to strong sales during the holidays, the company recorded a profit for the first time in years.
多虧假期期間銷售強勁，這家公司多年來首次創下獲利。
break a record: The young swimmer managed to break a record that had stood for more than twenty years.
那位年輕的泳將成功打破了一項保持超過二十年的紀錄。
off the record: The mayor told reporters off the record that he was planning to retire next year.
市長私下跟記者說，他打算明年退休。
for the record: For the record, I never said I didn't like your cooking; I only said I was already full.
鄭重聲明，我從沒說過我不喜歡你做的菜；我只說我已經吃飽了。
a record high: Temperatures in Taipei reached a record high of 39 degrees this summer, and many people stayed indoors.
今年夏天台北氣溫達到三十九度的歷史新高，許多人都待在室內。
